description_en: Describes the database accounts of a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 查询指定云数据库ClickHouse集群的数据库账号信息
name: DescribeAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

If this parameter is not specified, the operation queries information about all database accounts
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的名称。
如果不配置该参数，默认查询所有数据库账号的信息
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值如下：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页数，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

AccountDescription.description_en: The description of the database account

AccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

AccountStatus.description_en:
The status of the database account. Valid values:

Creating: The account is being created.

Available: The account is active.

AuthorityModifying: The permissions of the account are being modified.

Deleting: The account is being deleted.

Only database accounts that are configured using XML files can be in the AuthorityModifying state
AccountStatus.description_zh:
数据库账号的状态，取值说明：

Creating：创建中。

Available：可用。

AuthorityModifying： 权限变更中。

Deleting：删除中。 

仅XML配置方式的数据账号才会有AuthorityModifying状态

AccountType.description_en:
The type of the database account. Valid values:

Super: a privileged account.

Normal: a standard account
AccountType.description_zh:
数据库账号的类型，取值说明：
Super：高权限账号。
Normal：普通账号

ConfigType.description_en: The configuration method of the database account
ConfigType.description_zh: 数据库账号的配置方式

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
